name: Idle Cave Miner 2
detailed_description:
Assemble your team, and find out what lurks deep in the mines of Idle Cave Miner 2!

Idle Cave Miner 2 is an idle incremental game where you mine resources, craft items, and upgrade your team of miners. Explore unique worlds, where you can battle monsters and acquire items to help you on your journey. Unlock miners, pets, items, achievements, and hundreds of upgrades to go deeper than ever on your quest to find the mythical wishing gem, which is said to provide a wish to the one who finds it. Does it exist? Who are these miners, and what are their wishes? What mysteries await them?

What's new on Idle Cave Miner 2:

Idle Cave Miner 2 takes everything you loved about the first game and makes it better than ever with a fresh new look, completely reworked progression, and an updated roster of miners. A major new addition is the Combat World, where you'll be able to fight monsters and defeat bosses to acquire unique items. The interface is clearer, animations are smoother, and progression has been redesigned from the ground up to provide a balanced experience as you travel between worlds, and go deeper than ever to uncover the mysteries of the mines.

Idle Cave Miner 2 Features:

  • Miners:

    Unlock and upgrade 20+ miners with special abilities to reach the depths of the mines. Assemble the ultimate mining crew, and watch out for powerful synergies between miners.

  • Destructible Mines:

    You and your team will break through each mine, one block at a time! When no blocks are left standing in your path, you venture deeper into the mines.

  • Unique Worlds:

    Explore 3 unique worlds, each with its own gameplay and upgrades, and gather special resources to unlocks upgrades in the other worlds. The "Mining world" where your goal is to go as deep as possible, the "Combat world", where you will fight monsters and defeat bosses, and the "Ancient world", where you will restore functionality to the ancient tower and to the mysterious hand.

  • Forging:

    Process the resources your miners gather into their refined version, and use those for powerful upgrades to aid you in your journey. Upgrade your forges to make this process faster, and develop a strategy for optimal production.

  • Researches:

    As you collect more and more resources, you'll be able to unlock researches, these will provide strong boosts to you and your miners, pick the best options for your style of gameplay and conquer the mines!

  • Pets:

    Pets are here to aid the miners on their journey, they provide boosts to your miners to help them progress further into the depths.

  • Market:

    Too much of one resource? Too little of another? The market is the solution for you, sell your items for a common currency, and then exchange that currency for the item you need. Want better rates? The daily deals provide you with unique exchange opportunities, although these have limited stock.

  • Prestige:

    Collect lost souls along your descent, and when you're ready, prestige those souls into miner souls, you'll start over from the first floor, however, you can use these souls to unlock extremely powerful upgrades, regaining your previous progress much faster than before.

  • Combat World:

    Fight monsters, and defeat powerful bosses with your hero. Increase its strength to be able to face increasingly powerful foes. Travel between various areas, discover dungeons filled with formidable opponents, and use the spoils of battle to your advantage.

  • Ancient World:

    Power up an ancient tower as you uncover the mysteries of this ancient world, there seems to be a hand here? What does it do, and how can it be effectively used? What are these artifacts? So many questions...

  • Achievements:

    Unlock tons of achievements, these are not just visual, you don't just get rewards, but also permanent boosts to your soul collection. How many will you be able to get?

  • Leaderboards:

    Global leaderboards! Conquer the ranks and try to reach the top, each world has its own ranking, based on the progression of that world.

  • Lore:

    Unlock the history of this world as you go deeper into the mines, and find out whether the mythical wishing stone exists or not. Everything has a secret, who are these miners? What do they want? What mysteries await them in the depths of the mines?
